I rarely leave reviews for anything.  Frankly I usually cannot be arsed.  Unless I feel really compelled to do so.  In this case, having seen some of the reviews here, which are mostly positive, but a few horribly and unnecessarily negative reviews I thought I would make an exception and offer my input.  I am the clinics longest running patient,  I was 50/51 when I first walked in when they opened up 9 or 10 years ago and I have been on a monthly program ever since.  I am now 59.  And I am doing great. Thats largely thanks to Dr Tim and his great team.  I pay my money every month and I get ongoing monitoring  and adjustments to treatment as and when needed. The first step was to fix the problems and then its ongoing maintenance from then on.  I am not a body builder - that was not my reason or purpose in seeking help. I came to see Dr Tim because I have multiple chronic immune system disorders caused by heavy and prolonged chemical exposure at age +/- 20 which basically screwed up my hormones (among other things).  Since age 27 I have been on TRT therapy plus Cortisol (for Addisons disease) and Thyroid hormones (hypo).  I have had dedicated endocrinologists in the UK, in Hong Kong, Spain, and Bangkok (Bumrungrad hospital) - basically anywhere I have lived long term I have needed professional monitoring and support - literally if I don’t take my meds correctly I die.  It’s that simple. Let alone being able to have an active sex life or have a great body. Staying alive and well is my first priority.  I have had to educate myself along the way - even my previous endocrinologists and other doctors have acknowledged that I am a very rare case. No less than 6 autoimmune disorders. Ergo at this point I know more about the totality of my condition than any single doctor I have ever met.  And yet I live a normal, VERY active life (wink wink, if you know what I mean). I look better, I feel better and life is good! Thanks to Dr Tim and his team.  Because of my past experiences (my medical files in hospitals around the word are probably thousands of pages by now) I have learned to question everything - especially advice and treatments offered by various so called medical professionals (albeit seemingly highly qualified).    I was told, at age 27, by my then consultant at Derriford hospital in the UK, that I would be in a wheelchair within 2 years because of my disorders, He gave me antidepressants and that was it. Of course I ignored his advice and never went back.  I realised there and then that the mainstream medical profession wasn’t there to help me and I learned to question EVERYTHING.  What I have especially appreciated with Dr Tim is that he actually LISTENS.  And he really doesn’t mind when I question something (as I often do). That’s a key part in understanding any problem and then being open minded about the solution. It’s like teamwork. He works with you to find the best way forward.    In my case the solution was fundamentally about changing to a healthy diet (avoid anything that is processed basically) and tweak and maintain the hormones to optimum levels.  The diet part is easy, I didn’t need the clinics help for that. The hormone part is very very complex obviously and that’s where I really needed help.   In my experience Dr Tim is always totally professional and methodical in his approach. At the same time he is not afraid to think ‘outside of the box’ - which is just what I needed.  I see a few silly complaints on here about price - which seems like nonsense to me - the reality is they are neither expensive nor cheap - fairly priced I would say.  To my mind the price is irrelevant anyway.  What price can you put on your health and quality of life?  My case is extremely complex to say the least.  If Dr Tim and his team can handle me and fix my problems, which they have, then I think any relatively normal person should have no doubts whatsoever about the service here.  Happy to confirm anythign if any one has doubts - ask the staff for my cell phone.

First, a little background. I'm an American, but I have a condo in Thailand. Almost 20 years ago, I was diagnosed with a massive tumor in my optical chiasm, the area in the brain where the optical nerves criss-cross from one hemisphere to the other. It was causing me to lose my eyesight, and immediate surgery was required. The upshot is that my pituitary gland was destroyed when the tumor was removed, meaning I'd need to be on testosterone replacement therapy for the rest of my life. In the U.S., getting a prescription for testosterone can be difficult, even when you have a well-documented medical need for it, as I do. Then there's the insurance issue. I've often had to do battle with my insurance company over getting testosterone treatments, and any time I changed insurers, the problems started all over again. Moving from one state to another made matters even worse. The people at my (very expensive) insurance were useless. Anyway... I came to Thailand three years ago, and with my supply of testosterone dwindling I went into the Maximum Performance Center in Pattaya to see if they could help me. My life got so much better that day! Getting on a regular schedule of injections was easy, and the cost includes regular blood testing and monitoring of not only my testosterone levels, but other critical blood components, too. I was able to start immediately. I didn't have to wait six weeks for a consultation with a doctor, then wait another month for a referral to a specialist, and then spend another two months arguing with my insurance company over whether the treatments were even warranted (that routine seemed to be the norm for me in the U.S.). Fortunately, quality health care is much more accessible here in Thailand. I've been going to Maximum Performance for over two years now, except for brief periods when I was visiting other countries, or when I've had to travel back to the United States. My doctor at Maximum Performance is always available if I have questions (either in person or on the Line app), and the staff have always been friendly and very efficient. The monthly price of the treatments sounds high when quoted in Thai Baht, but when you convert it to U.S. dollars it's actually an incredible value. For me, it's less than half of my old co-pay. I happily pay "out of pocket" because the cost is so reasonable. I also don't have to book separate appointments with a diagnostic lab (like Quest - yuck!) and then wait to hear from my endocrinologist to go over the test results. Everything is handled in one location, and those test results are ready the very next day. In summary, Maximum Performance has been a game-changer for me. Something that was a major headache for almost 20 years has been reduced to the simple task of stopping in twice a week for a quick shot. Easy peasy! FIVE STARS from me.
